title: Replace all uses of proto_tree_add_text_internal in dissectors
description: This was NOT intended for dissectors as it allows creation of fields that can't be filtered on (i.e. the original proto_tree_add_text).  There were a few internal places in epan where this couldn't be removed, so the function remains, but it SHOULD NOT be used in dissectors.

notes.body: I know you're just copying the original message, but it stuck out to me.
Might as well fix it if we're here.

changed this line in [version 2 of the diff](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/22642/diffs?diff_id=1591015767&start_sha=7da28c964be426175664d6149efc1e5a7729b835#6e492a34487af8c7ae7f1e874ff3c3916e1dde58_1821_1821)
Honestly I would like long term to get rid of all the uses of `proto_tree_add_subtree_format` in favor of FT_NONE because of #17125 and related issues, but that's a longer project.

Have you looked at convert_proto_tree_add_text.pl?  That was the tool I wrote many years ago to get rid of all of the proto_tree_add_text calls, which seems to have similar motivations.
Today, I stumbled upon the proto_tree_add_text_internal use (what proto_tree_add_text was renamed to force finding all uses) and was annoyed that it was allowed to creep back into the dissectors.   Hopefully the comments are clearer now.
Could it be banned via checkAPIs.pl and check_dissectors.py? Another option would be having a `proto-int.h` header and putting the declaration there to discourage using it.

Replace all uses of proto_tree_add_text_internal in dissectors

This was NOT intended for dissectors as it allows creation of fields that can't be filtered on (i.e. the original proto_tree_add_text).  There were a few internal places in epan where this couldn't be removed, so the function remains, but it SHOULD NOT be used in dissectors.
